modern: Constantly regard the universe as one living being, having one substance and one soul; and observe how all things relate to one perception, the perception of this one living being; and how all things act with one movement; and how all things are the cooperating causes of all things which exist; observe too the continuous spinning of the thread and the weaving of the web.
